claims.claim: Registers Local, Global, reindex, and status commands plus Ctrl+R Local search.
Defaults the persistent database and source-session locations under the Pi agent directory.
Parses session JSONL and indexes only text from user-role messages.
Stores full prompt text, cwd, session metadata, timestamps, previews, and hashes in SQLite tables.
Filters Local queries by exact cwd while Global queries read all indexed prompt rows.
Discovers all session files for Global refresh and only the current cwd directory for Local refresh.
The copy action replaces editor text and sends the selected prompt to clipboard handling.
Clipboard handling emits OSC 52 and then attempts a platform-native clipboard path.
Restore switches to the selected session, while fork switches when needed and branches from the selected entry.
